Name: Foribus Regis - Caleb di Flagro and Co. (New Interactive NPCs)
Author: Claridel
Description:
[center][u][color=#00ff00][size=5][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][b]NEWEST UPDATES 2.0.0 (2026 July)[/b][/font][/size][/color][/u]
[left][list=1]
[*][color=#00ff00][size=3][b]NEW NPCs Hiro Mynos and Astrea Leidenschaft (Year 2 and beyond)[/b][/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#00ff00][size=3][b]New Portraits for Caleb, Hiro, and Astrea[/b][/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#00ff00][size=3][b]Brand new Story Events for Caleb, from 2 Hearts until 10 Hearts, and other special events![/b][/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#00ff00][size=3][b]After Year 2 and some introductions, Caleb can now barter with the players! [/b][/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#00ff00][size=3][b]After having 10 Hearts with Caleb, Hiro, and Astrea, a special event will occur and they will craft something for the players. Catch up with the trio and find out.[/b][/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#00ff00][size=3][b]The three of them now attends Festivals... and if you have Ridgeside Village, they'll be in the festivals of that village too![/b][/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#00ff00][size=3][b]New items, can be gained after having 10 Hearts with the Foribus Regis Trio.[/b][/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#00ff00][size=3][b][b][s]NPC Adventures recruitable [/s](Disabled until this separate mod is updated)[/b][/b][/size][/color][/*]
[/list][/left]
[left][/left]
[left][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][u][u][b][img]https://i.ibb.co/gy5rRMV/Title-Banner-Outfits.png[/img][/b][/u][/u][/font][size=1][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]Caption: Concept Designs for Caleb di Flagro (2023) shown above for the original series "Quantuarian Chronicles"[/font][/size][/left]
[left]
[/left]
[left][u][b][u][u][size=4][font=Impact]===== ===== [u]==[/u] ===== =====[/font][/size][/u][/u][/b][/u][/left]
[left][b][b][size=5][font=Verdana]INTRODUCTION[/font][/size][/b][/b][/left]
[left][u][u][b][u][u][size=4][font=Impact]===== ===== [u]==[/u] ===== =====[/font][/size][/u][/u][/b][/u][/u][/left]
[left]|-- [font=Arial][b][color=#ff7700]Caleb di Flagro[/color][/b] is a youthful man in his late 20s from the [color=#ff7700]Dukedom of Sistenasi[/color]. He's the scion and next-in-line for the position of "Duke" in his hometown and is also a member of the renowned guild [color=#ff7700]Foribus Regis[/color], known for assisting people in neighboring countries. His guild master, Solana Nereida, has assigned him the mission of forming a connection with Stardew Valley and its residents, aiming to establish a partnership. [/font][/left]
[left][/left]
[left][font=Arial]|-- And as time pass by, he will be joined by two members of Foribus Regis: Hiro Mynos, a sarcastic yet chatterbox Inventor, and Astrea Ledidenschaft, a reserved, intellectual, and thoughtful Geologist. Get to know Caleb and his acquaintances and watch their stories unfold as you progress through your relationships for each individual.[/font]
[/left]
[left][center][img]https://i.imgur.com/ZVHtLfK.gif[/img][/center]
[center][size=1][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]Caption: Year 2 Conversation between the Foribus Regis Members[/font][/size][/center]
[/left]

[left]|-- After the release of Version 2.0.0, Caleb di Flagro will now be compatible with another "Caleb Mod" by Shiitenayo[/left]

[left]And right after, Astrea followed.
[/left]
